leaf_boundary: Stochastic input and independent unit-exponential partial-sum background. Process definitions and their actual-input composition are preserved as excluded consumers, not proved or credited.

semantic_slots.objects: A probability space (Omega,F,P) and measurable real random variables E_n, n>=1, each with unit exponential law and mutually independent as a countable family. A concrete product space is a legitimate realization, but is not named or constructed by the source.
semantic_slots.domains: Source clock labels are positive integers. Exponential values are finite nonnegative reals with strict positivity almost surely. The source infinity symbols belong to waiting/jump times and positive divergence, not to infinite-valued clocks. The sum is j=1,...,n.
semantic_slots.quantifiers: The source fixes y,x-tilde and the initial state, giving a common finite pathwise C=bar-lambda_E(y,x-tilde). Clock properties and divergence are almost-sure over the clock sequence. For each fixed finite C>0, scaled partial sums diverge. A single common full-measure event for all positive real C is mathematically available from unscaled divergence, but is an explicit generalization, not a new source claim.
semantic_slots.assumptions: SOURCE: full independence and every law Exp(1). TYPING/source-implicit: probability measure and measurable finite real random variables. Positivity, integrability, mean 1, SLLN and divergence must be discharged as law properties/theorem edges if used; they cannot be smuggled into the public source input as additional premises. No gradient, energy, cap, recursion or process assumption is needed for the clock-sum background.
semantic_slots.conclusion: At minimum preserve the stated independent Exp(1) input. Any claimed partial-sum coverage must establish almost-sure divergence of sum_{j=1}^n E_j and its division by positive fixed C; the author obtains this through SLLN with positive mean 1. This does not itself yield any T_n statement.
semantic_slots.scopes_and_senses: The author says almost surely, not for every outcome. A law-identical coordinate can be zero or invalid on a null set unless the carrier enforces support. Countably many clocks can be simultaneously positive almost surely. Extended-real infimum with empty set infinity and recursion termination are downstream conventions. Finite waiting comparison is conditional on S_{n+1}<infinity; never require every waiting time to be finite.
semantic_slots.constant_dependencies: Unit exponential parameter is exactly 1. Clock law and raw sum divergence have no y,x-tilde,eta,beta,energy,dimension or cap dependence. Source C depends on eta,beta,initial shifted harmonic energy and c_{y,x-tilde}-x-tilde. C>0 is required only for division; C=0 has a distinct no-jump branch. Negative C is outside source cap semantics.

law_semantics.unit_exponential: For x<0, P(E_n<=x)=0; for x>=0, P(E_n<=x)=1-exp(-x). Equivalently the density is exp(-x) on x>=0, normalized to mass 1. P(E_n>0)=1 and expectation E_n=1.
law_semantics.support_caution: A real-valued product carrier contains null exceptional sequences outside support unless restricted. Distributional support and almost-sure positivity do not imply pointwise positivity at every carrier point. No atom at 0; endpoint <= versus < has no probability difference for this law, but pathwise hazard conventions still matter.
law_semantics.independence: Use mutual finite-subfamily independence or an equivalent countable-family formulation. Pairwise independence alone is not the source assumption.
law_semantics.realization_caution: A product measure of identical unit-exponential factors may realize the source input; require a probability certificate, coordinate measurability, coordinate laws and mutual independence if this realization is claimed. The source itself supplies no explicit product-space formula.
law_semantics.generalization_caution: A theorem for a chosen canonical sequence is one realization of the source let-statement, not automatically a theorem about every iid sequence or a composed PDMP.

index_and_limit_contract.positive_source_index: E_1 is the first clock, used by S_1 in A.1 at n=0; no E_0 appears in the source.
index_and_limit_contract.zero_based_adapter: If a formal sequence X:Nat->Real is used, record E_{j+1}=X_j. Then sum_{j=1}^n E_j = sum_{k=0}^{n-1} X_k. The empty partial sum at n=0 is zero. A shifted sum must have its explicit bridge; natural-index convenience does not change A.1.
index_and_limit_contract.slln: Almost surely (1/n)*sum_{j=1}^n E_j -> 1 as n->infinity; this is the standard normalization underlying the author named SLLN.
index_and_limit_contract.divergence: Almost surely for every real B there exists N such that every n>=N has sum_{j=1}^n E_j>B. For fixed finite C>0 the same is true after division by C.
index_and_limit_contract.zero_cap: Do not state scaled divergence at C=0. Lean real division at zero or a fallback cannot encode the source no-jump branch.
index_and_limit_contract.infinity: Do not replace the empty hazard set by waiting time 0, replace stop by infinite recursion, assume finite waiting times globally, or turn positive divergence of finite sums into an assertion that a finite partial sum equals infinity.

original_author_route.name: independent-unit-exponentials -> named SLLN -> positive-mean sum divergence -> positive-cap scaling
original_author_route.no_observed_alternative_stochastic_route: The bounded source does not give a Borel-Cantelli, gamma-tail, or renewal alternative proof. Such a Lean route would be explicit implementation provenance, not the original author route.

nodes.content: A mutually independent sequence (E_n)_{n>=1}, each with unit exponential law.
Measurable finite-valued real clocks on a probability space realizing the independent laws. The source does not choose a sample space or product-measure construction.
Unit exponential clocks are positive almost surely, integrable and have mean 1. These are standard law properties, not extra source premises.
The author invokes SLLN for the independent identically distributed unit-exponential sequence; normalized partial sums converge to the positive mean.

No proof or precise bibliographic statement of SLLN, nor construction of its probability space, is supplied here. Record the actual reusable theorem used in Lean as implementation provenance; this is not a claim that the source assertion is false.
Almost surely, sum_{j=1}^n E_j -> +infinity, and therefore (sum_{j=1}^n E_j)/C -> +infinity for every fixed finite real C>0.
Integrated-hazard hitting time, recursion, finite waiting condition, and infinity stop branch.
Preserved shifted harmonic energy plus beta-Lipschitz gradient yield a finite nonnegative common pathwise rate cap C and hazard<=C*u.
C=0 gives vanishing rate and no jumps; no division by C occurs.
For C>0 and every finite waiting time, S_{n+1}>=E_{n+1}/C.
If recursion does not terminate, finite waiting lower bounds sum to T_n>=sum_{j=1}^n E_j/C.
No finite accumulation and a unique process for all t>=0 are later source conclusions, not furnished by the stochastic leaf alone.
Memorylessness gives time-homogeneous Markov property; Davis [12, Section 2] identifies integrated hazard construction. Neither is source credit for a partial-sum leaf.

edges.premises_discharged: identical unit-exponential laws give identical mean and integrability; full independence is the stated source input
positive limiting mean 1 forces raw sums to diverge; divide only by a fixed finite C>0
C>0 and S_{n+1}<infinity are explicit conditional scope; cap and hazard bound are proved dependencies
C=0; nonnegative event rate bounded above by zero vanishes; positive clock support is almost-sure unless the sample carrier enforces it
nontermination and finite-step recursion; sum from j=1 through n
actual recursion and actual cap must be connected; not established by the clock leaf
separate source branch; never combine zero and positive branches as a false AND
memorylessness is an additional source law property and the actual construction is required

source_graph.branch_semantics: C=0, C>0 with termination, and C>0 with nontermination are separate source cases. They cannot be flattened into an AND of all branch premises. The stochastic sum result is upstream of the positive-cap nonterminating composition only.
